Beat the cottage cheese until creamy and lump-free. In a
bowl, combine with the Greek yogurt, light cream cheese,
protein powder or sweetener, vanilla extract, and mix well until
you obtain a smooth and homogeneous cream.
2. Soak the base
Quickly dip the slices of wholemeal bread (or tiramisu
biscuits) in the coffee, on both sides, without soaking them
too much so they don't fall apart.
3. Assembling the layers
In a bowl or baking dish, make a layer of the coffee-soaked
base. Cover with a layer of the cream. Repeat the layers until
all ingredients are used, always finishing with cream.
4. Finish
Sprinkle generously with cocoa powder. Refrigerate for about
2 hours and serve.
